name: world_bank_indicators
description: Queries the World Bank Open Data API to fetch macroeconomic indicators such as GDP growth, inflation, and population for any country.

country.description: ISO2 or ISO3 country code (e.g., US, IN, GB, DE)

indicator.description: World Bank indicator code or alias (e.g., NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG for GDP growth, FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG for inflation, SP.POP.TOTL for population)

years.description: Number of recent annual observations to return (default 5)
